changelog:
- YouTube Shorts Auto-Skipping: Automatically fast-swipes sponsored Shorts and advertiser placements in the official YouTube app.
- Accelerated Instagram Reels Ad Skipping: Ultra-fast 90ms swipe gesture with 350ms response time for sponsored Instagram Reels.
- Feed Purity: Eliminated timeline auto-scrolling on Instagram home feed, X, and Reddit, focusing exclusively on full-screen short-form video feeds.
